:::{#def-cv-se}
#### Fold-based standard error

The **fold-based standard error** $\cvse$
of a $k$-fold [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate)
is the [sample standard deviation](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-sd)
of the $k$ [fold mean squared errors](#def-fold-mse),
divided by $\sqrt{k}$:

$$
\cvse \eqdef \frac{\hSD{\foldmse{1}, \ldots, \foldmse{k}}}{\sqrt{k}}.
$$ {#eq-cv-se}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
#### Source

@hastie2009elements [sec. 7.10.1], who call the result a standard error.
:::

:::
